description: This file defines a PHP class named Notification within the Opencart Admin Controller Common namespace. The class handles fetching notifications from a remote server and managing user notifications by interacting with models and cookies. It appears to be part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform's administrative backend, specifically for managing system notifications displayed to the administrator.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: A controller class managing system notifications in the OpenCart admin backend, including fetching updates via API and handling notification display logic.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that checks for a notification cookie, fetches notifications from the OpenCart server, processes received notification data, and updates notifications via a model.
